card.name: "the" before morning or evening dosing
card.fires_on: The word "the" right after "in" when a drug is given once daily and the next word is likely "morning" or "evening". Weaker on a few other time or date words such as "on" before a day number.

modes.label: Time-of-day dosing
modes.description: "the" after "in" in once-daily dosing instructions, where morning or evening comes next.
modes.example: Sertraline hydrochloride should be administered once daily, either in<< the>> morning or evening.

modes.label: Dates and day phrases
modes.description: Words in date or schedule phrases, such as "on" before a day number or "end" in "year's end".

card.writes: It promotes odd non-time tokens and suppresses time-of-day words like morning, night and day, so it holds back repeating a time word.
card.plain: It lights up on "the" in "in the morning/evening" dosing instructions, just before the time of day is named.
